notes: Native firmware 0.1.34 — the P337 navigation suppression LIFTED: the post-handshake navigation (splash -> screensaver + the relay state re-sync) is back. The authored splash never auto-advances, so with the suppression every boot sat on the logo forever and the physical switch zones (which live on home) were unreachable — the user's report. The P337 'goes deaf' suspicion was falsified by P352 (the served file switched mid-transfer). The navigation's writes are inert while the TFT task holds raw mode. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
